title: Agency agent frontmatter
_note: The YAML frontmatter contract for an agent .md file. Version 1.0.0 describes the CONTRACT AS IT EXISTS -- it is deliberately descriptive, not aspirational, so it can be enforced today without changing a single agent. It was derived by parsing all 270 agents with a real YAML parser, not from documentation. The canonical `id` field arrives in 1.1.0 (Phase 3); do not add it here. Validate with scripts/lib/frontmatter.py. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the prose version of this contract and docs/frontmatter.md for where the legacy toolchain disagrees with it.

name.description: Human-readable display name, Title Case (e.g. 'Frontend Developer'). NOT an identifier: 13 of 16 tools derive their output filename by slugifying this, so changing it silently re-homes generated files. The pattern forbids leading and trailing whitespace, which get_field would otherwise pass through into rendered output.

description.description: One-line summary of the agent's specialty. Weighted heavily by the Hermes router when selecting a specialist, so vagueness here costs routing accuracy. Must be a single line: every parser in the distribution layer reads one line per key, so a multi-line value is silently truncated.

color.description: A named colour or a #RRGGBB hex value. Named colours outside the set scripts/convert.sh resolve_opencode_color knows are rendered as grey #6B7280 by OpenCode; the schema permits them because they are valid per the contract, and the linter reports them separately.

emoji.description: Single emoji used in listings and in the OpenClaw IDENTITY.md heading.

vibe.description: One-line personality hook. Optional: 269 of 270 agents have one.

tools.description: Comma-separated tool names (e.g. 'WebFetch, WebSearch, Read, Write, Edit'). Carried through to Qwen and ZCode output verbatim when present. A string rather than a list because that is what the corpus and the renderers use.

author.description: Attribution for contributed agents. Present on 7 of 270.

services.description: External services the agent depends on. DECLARED BUT UNUSED: no converter carries this field into any of the 14 output formats, because get_field cannot read a block value. Documented in CONTRIBUTING.md, so it is a real part of the contract and is validated here -- but a consumer must not expect it downstream until a renderer reads it.
